My four exclusive files + `publication-work.md` are mine; the other `V6-remediation/*` entries (authority-review, recovery-design, recovery-work, runs/, security-authority-first/) belong to the concurrent seats and I did not touch them. No commit made.

## Corrections applied (all four points)

**1 — Capture criterion now matches fsck exactly.** A gap is only `!Published && Op∈{observe.tool, observe.stop} && Outcome==core.OutcomeOK && BytesHash nonzero` (fsck.go:1111-1118, calibration rule 2). The minimal view now decodes `outcome` and `bytes_hash`. Denied/absent/error outcomes, ok-without-durable-bytes, and prompts are `LegitimatelyUnpublished`, never promoted to gaps. Version must **equal** `CaptureSidecarVersion` (newer = support-gap note; older/zero/missing = unreadable) — both incomplete. Unknown/missing outcome and unknown op → incomplete. New tests: denied, empty-ok, unknown outcome, unknown op, future schema, missing/older schema, malformed trailing JSON.

**2 — Genuinely bounded.** A shared `scanBudget` caps total directory entries visited (files, subdirs, unknown entries, symlinks all charged) and total bytes read, including the pending registry. Directories are read in fixed 256-entry batches (`os.File.ReadDir`), never slurped whole; depth fixed at two fanout levels (no `WalkDir`). ctx checked every batch. Symlinks/reparse points are never traversed or read. Per-sidecar read capped at ~8 MiB (derived from `config.HookCaptureHardCapBytes`), not 64 MiB; too-large → incomplete; `json.Unmarshal` over the bounded buffer catches trailing garbage. New tests: entry-budget truncation, cancellation.

**3 — Object candidates reported honestly.** Renamed `UnindexedObjectCandidates`, documented as including both crash-orphans (F4-1) and tombstoned-but-unswept objects (not distinguished — needs tombstone replay). Verified in source that KeepRaw/delta/retained-original objects go through `appendRoot → chunkSet`, so `indexHasChunk` alone is correct; added a real CRLF+KeepRaw fixture proving zero false positives (confirmed it records a side record — ≥2 roots). The F4 cut still fires the generic LOUD.

**4 — Cancellation honored**; the pass returns partial counts + `context.Canceled` for main's short startup deadline; unknown/error states stay explicit. `observe.stop` included only under the same outcome/bytes criterion as tool, per your approval.
